correctness.rationale: For n>=3 simple cycles, p-k mod n is invariant, reducing the map to flipping the binary rotor bit at its Hamming-weight index. Explicit 2n recurrent words per offset, plus two exact decreasing potentials prove the piecewise preperiod formula for all rotor states including constant words. Strict rearrangement gives max (n-1)(n-2)/2 and precisely 2n maxima. An elementary independent-bit expectation gives (n^2-5n+8)/4-2^(1-n). Complete functional-graph and independent direct-update checks agree for n=3..14 and n=3..13, respectively; numerical tests support rather than replace the proof.

value.rationale: Exact first-periodic-entry is a natural dynamics observable distinct from rotor Euler-circuit length and vertex cover time. A complete closed-state formula, sharp all-n worst-case transient, exact count 2n of extremizers, and rational mean with exponentially small correction give structurally motivated information for deterministic walk initialization, not a narrow arbitrary finite slice.
